draft_text: Ferrule generally achieved a higher test AUROC than Arbor-GBT across the six-dataset tabular suite.
revised_text: Ferrule generally achieved a higher test AUROC than Arbor-GBT across the six-dataset tabular suite.
rationale: T1 shows Ferrule higher on 5 of 6 datasets (r1, r2, r4, r5, r6) and lower on r3 (Ivel-Fraud). "Generally" correctly captures the majority-but-not-all pattern. No statistical test reported, so no significance claim is made. Claim matches evidence.
